mentions.name: New Carry-On
mentions.description: A website that helps travelers sort luggage items by weight and check airline carry-on compatibility, making it easier to pack within airline weight limits.
mentions.problem: Finding lightweight carry-on luggage is hard because airline weight checks often push bags near the limit.
mentions.source_excerpt:
so i created a site to help me sort things by weight and airline compatibility:

https://newcarryon.com/
